composition_subtypes.role: sorts elements by a_i ascending and negative offset descending to enforce valid selection order
computes longest increasing subsequence of offsets to find maximum number of index-value matches

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorts elements by a_i then decreasing offset (i+1-a_i) to order candidates; then uses 1D DP (LIS) on offsets to select maximum valid indices.
payload.rationale: The solution relies on sorting to arrange elements in order of their value and then applies a 1D DP (LIS) to pick a sequence that satisfies the rank constraints.
